summary: Focused regression on the CORS/login bug fix. Verified CORS preflight now returns 200 through public URL for /api/auth/login, /api/auth/forgot-password and /api/auth/change-password (previously 400). Verified evil.com preflight against localhost is still rejected (400). Frontend browser test: /login?staff=1 with wrong password shows 'Credenciais inválidas' toast, correct super admin login shows 'Bem-vinda, Super Admin' and redirects to /plataforma/studios. /minha-conta login history shows the new browser entry at the top. No CORS errors, no failed OPTIONS in browser console/network.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS regex is well-scoped to https:// only and to emergentagent.com/emergentcf.cloud/emergent.host with allow_credentials=True — safe; localhost evil.com preflight correctly returns 400.
server.py is ~1994 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, platform, studios, etc.) for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS fix (allow_origin_regex for emergentagent.com/emergentcf.cloud/emergent.host) is validated end-to-end. Note: ingress rewrites Origin to https://<id>.cluster-2.preview.emergentcf.cloud — that is the host the ACAO header echoes.
rca of the issue: Cloud ingress rewrites the browser Origin header to https://<id>.cluster-2.preview.emergentcf.cloud, which was not in CORS_ORIGINS env list. FastAPI CORSMiddleware rejected the preflight (400 'Disallowed CORS origin'), causing the browser to show generic 'Falha no login' network error. Fix: added allow_origin_regex covering *.emergentagent.com|emergentcf.cloud|emergent.host in server.py:1989 while keeping allow_credentials=True. Verified via curl (public URL preflight = 200 with ACAO header) and Playwright login flow (no CORS errors, successful login toast, redirect, history entry recorded).
